home.heading: SaaS, marketplace and MVP development
paragraphs: Palisoft is the full-stack development studio of Yuri Palienko. We design the architecture, build the backend with Node.js and NestJS and the frontend with React and Next.js, ship the product to production and support it after launch.

Track record: a fleet-management SaaS grown from scratch to 500+ corporate clients, a B2C car rental marketplace, a Power BI-grade analytics system with an AI agent and ClickHouse/DuckDB analytics, plus our own products in EdTech and PropTech.
We work remotely, worldwide, in English and Russian. Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis, Three.js.
